miniProject.title: Token-policy rollouts with versioned trajectory contracts
miniProject.brief: Extend `policylab` with an `llm/` trajectory laboratory on a tiny CPU text policy: boundaries, masks, rewards, roles and immutable rollout records. Prove scoring against fixed oracles before any update, and account every token and verifier call. Move to a small decoder only if your GPU fits it.
steps: Fix the state, action, trajectory and reward boundary for one small task in `llm/`, check it against hand-computed trajectory probabilities, then write the bandit, token or environment formulation with its hidden-state list and the optimizer it permits.

Implement prompt, completion, padding and EOS masks on the rollout records, pass the RLHF Book masked-aggregation script on them, then place per-token rewards with the outcome at EOS, propagate returns, and log KL, reward and return traces with truncation handled apart.

Freeze a base model, train a small SFT baseline and an evaluation baseline in `llm/`, assign every tensor to policy, reference, critic, reward or verifier, and record checkpoint identity with frozen-or-trainable status for every later stage.

Store immutable versioned rollout records in `llm/` with old log probabilities written once, all five outcome classes counted, and sampling, training and evaluation prompts separated with dedup, then prove a stored-versus-recomputed test and a fixed log-probability and mask oracle.
Recompute the companion token KL hand calculation on the rollout traces, then record token entropy, sequence diversity and reference KL with the estimator and direction named on every number.

Account raw tokens, verifier calls, latency and compute for each sampling run in `ledger/`, compare learned change against best-of-N and self-consistency at matched budgets, and preserve failed runs with explicit reasons.
deliverables: Tiny text policy with boundary, formulation, masks and reward placement proved on fixed oracles.
Immutable versioned rollout records with prompt splits, outcome classes and KL, compute and latency traces.
Frozen base, SFT and evaluation baselines with checkpoint identity and matched-budget selection controls.

checks.name: RLHF Book Chapter 6: masked aggregation script
checks.note: Run the aggregation script on rollout-shaped tensors; keep mask-sum evidence.

checks.name: Hands-on Modern RL 13.9: hand-calculate one token KL penalty
checks.note: Recompute the hand penalty on rollout traces; name the estimator.

rubric.pass: The aggregation script passes on rollout records, prompt positions carry zero weight, and EOS handling is decided and tested.
rubric.strong: A template-shift probe fails the oracle as designed, and per-sequence versus per-token weighting is defended.

rubric.pass: Per-token rewards put KL at every position with the outcome at EOS only, returns propagate by hand, and truncation takes no outcome score.
rubric.strong: Recorded KL, reward and return traces reconcile position by position on a held-out rollout.

rubric.pass: Every record binds policy, tokenizer, template, reward, verifier and RNG versions, stored log probabilities survive updates, and no outcome class is dropped.
rubric.strong: Sampling, training and evaluation splits share no prompt id, and prefix dedup evidence is kept.

rubric.pass: The ledger counts tokens, verifier calls, latency and compute, learned change beats matched selection, and failures stay counted.
rubric.strong: A small-decoder run, only if your GPU fits it, is reported apart with its own budget table.

miniProject.feedsInto: `llm/` records, oracles and baselines feed preference, online-policy and reasoning-agent projects and the capstone.
